name: Miyanoue Kanna
source:
Hobbies: Listening to music
Likes: Hanging out with her favorite people, milk
Dislikes: One-sided conversations, sticky food

[url=/c55449]Shinobu's[/url] popular classmate who, despite of her cool apperance, is actually a bit jealous and shy. However, she is very popular because of her gap moe. She became friends with Shinobu after a certain incident, and she is very shy around him. Unlike the people around her, she is quite naive and innocent about sex and perverted things in general. However, during sex, Kanna's hidden sadistic tendencies and personality show up completely.
